verses.1:
Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD;
 let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
verses.2:
Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving;
 let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
verses.3:
For the LORD is a great God,
 a great King above all gods.
verses.4:
In His hand are the depths of the earth,
 and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
verses.5:
The sea is His, for He made it,
 and His hands formed the dry land.
verses.6:
O come, let us worship and bow down;
 let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
verses.7:
For He is our God,
 and we are the people of His pasture,
 the sheep under His care.
 Today, if you hear His voice,
verses.8:
do not harden your hearts
 as you did at Meribah, + 95:8 LXX as you did in the rebellion ; Meribah means quarreling ; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7 ; cited in Hebrews 3:15 and Hebrews 4:7. 
 in the day at Massah in the wilderness, + 95:8 LXX in the day of testing in the wilderness ; Massah means testing ; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7 .
verses.9:
where your fathers tested and tried Me,
 though they had seen My work.
verses.10:
For forty years I was angry with that generation,
 and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, + 95:10 LXX They always go astray in the heart 
 and they have not known My ways.”
verses.11:
So I swore on oath in My anger,
 “They shall never enter My rest.” + 95:11 Cited in Hebrews 3:7–11|HEB 3:7-11 , Hebrews 4:3, and Hebrews 4:5
